items.content_html: Nextbase is a full-stack, self-hosted PostgreSQL management tool you deploy on your own server. Think of it as a lightweight, privacy-first alternative to Supabase Studio or pgAdmin — running entirely inside Docker on your VPS with no cloud dependency, no data leaving your server, and no subscription fees.
